disclaimer: A disproportionality signal (PRR/ROR) only means the drug/reaction pair was reported together more often than the background reporting rate predicts. It is NOT proof of causation, of a drug-drug interaction, of an increased clinical risk, or of incidence. FAERS has no exposure denominator and is affected by reporting, notoriety and duplicate bias.
grain: One report = one distinct (quarter, PRIMARYID). A drug/reaction contingency table is then built from distinct report membership, so multiple drugs or multiple reactions in one report never multiply a count.
